page: Microsoft Azure EC96ads_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECadsv6 family. It is equipped with 96 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system features 672.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 7.0 GB per vCPU.

For local data requirements, the instance includes 2458 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance persistent disk options. The configuration does not include any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high memory allocation of 672.0 GB and substantial local storage, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads and database applications. The high resource density of 96 dedicated vCPUs and 7.0 GB of RAM per core provides a qualitatively cost-efficient platform for enterprise applications, large-scale relational databases, and data analytics workloads that require significant memory capacity without the need for hardware acceleration.
